Iran's leadership faces internal divisions amid funeral and US conflict

Following Ayatollah Khamenei's funeral, Iran's hardliners are reportedly accusing government leaders of staging a 'soft coup' and plotting against the leadership. These accusations surface amidst escalating conflict with the US, following the deaths of American soldiers and subsequent US attacks on Iran. The internal political rifts highlight divisions over potential war or ceasefire negotiations with the US.
